episode_title: #155: The Art of AI Content Creation with Cybersecurity Expert David Mundy

real_qa.q: What is DeSera data security posture management and how does it differ from competitors in the market?
real_qa.r: DeSera focuses on discovering all data and creating compliance policies on top of it, sitting in the middle between data encryption/masking and data governance. Data security posture management involves discovery of data, classification, overlaying priority through policy engines, and access management. DeSera extends beyond these core DSPM functions with features like data usage and query analysis, differentiating through how people fundamentally use data and the speed of market education.
real_qa.requete: DeSera data security posture management DSPM

real_qa.q: How is AI being used in content creation and marketing at early-stage cybersecurity startups?
real_qa.r: David Mundy uses ChatGPT-4 and Claude to create content by first training the AI with specific company data and understanding the product, customer, market, and value proposition. Rather than asking AI to write full white papers directly, he starts with querying outlines, then works with combinations of tools and people. He trains ChatGPT with DeSera's value proposition and uses specific prompts to shift messaging toward security versus governance focuses.
real_qa.requete: using ChatGPT AI content creation startup marketing

real_qa.q: What was David Mundy's experience adopting ChatGPT for marketing work in 2023?
real_qa.r: Mundy began using generative AI specifically ChatGPT-4 since December 2022. Initially he found it gimmicky and frustrating because ChatGPT-3 had minimal memory and would forget initial prompts after three or four queries. Around March-April 2023, when ChatGPT-3.5 or GPT-4 launched, his querying and prompting approach changed significantly, moving from requesting full white papers (which produced nothing useful) to requesting outlines and training the model with specific data.

real_qa.q: How does DeSera compete in a market where less than 5% penetration exists for data security posture management?
real_qa.r: DeSera's biggest competitor is companies not yet prioritizing data security needs. With less than 5% market share and only 13-14 direct competitors in an ARR of 30-40 million total for the entire category, DeSera differentiates through education, marketing speed to market, white-glove customer support, and face-to-face engagement. The company has won deals by deploying CTO, co-founder, and solutions engineers on-site despite not always having the best product specifically for client needs.

real_qa.q: What were the key challenges David Mundy faced building marketing at DeSera with a small team?
real_qa.r: Mundy has three people on his marketing team: Jackie (brand, project management, communications) who has worked with him for 10 years across multiple companies, an events specialist handling events and email demand gen, and an SDR leader covering the bottom of funnel. The team started from seed round and built piece by piece, receiving Series A in April. They needed to build market trust, generate qualified leads, develop value propositions, move from product-market fit to go-to-market fit, and produce content validating DeSera's position.
real_qa.requete: startup marketing team structure David Mundy

real_qa.q: How has AI-driven phishing and social engineering evolved according to cybersecurity experts in 2023?
real_qa.r: David Mundy described receiving a phishing email claiming to be from Salesforce requesting $12,000 that looked completely legitimate except for a hard-to-spot email address. He also recounted being targeted at AWS reInvent 2021 with a text claiming to be from Amit Yoran, Tenable's CEO, asking him to buy gift cards—a sophisticated attack that briefly fooled him despite his cybersecurity background. Bad actors are using AI for hyper-personalization, localization, and scrounging social media information instantaneously.

guest.bio_context: David Mundy has spent approximately eight to nine years in the cybersecurity startup arena. He was at DiviCloud from 2017 to 2020 before it was acquired by Rapid7, then joined Acurix (an infrastructure as code security startup) which was acquired by Tenable within a year. He is currently VP Marketing at DeSera, a data security posture management startup that received its Series A funding in April with approximately 30 employees.

real_quote: You have to understand your product, you have to understand your customer, you have to understand your market, and then you understand how to use AI responsibly for content.
